create_parameter_controller: create an async parameter controller decorated with @controller to generate xm.JobGenerator for XManager experiments
build_docker_config: build a _DockerConfig dataclass with code_directory, docker_requirements, hw_requirements, and python_path for local docker launch
run_remote_controller: run a remote controller job launched via _launch_remote_controller with executor, controller args, env vars, and package path
serialize_functions: serialize PyNode functions into a pickle file using _serialize_functions with cloudpickle and user-friendly error messages
convert_to_python_container: convert a PyNode into an xm.PythonContainer via _to_python_container with a label and docker config for execution
